parts.text: You seem to be stuck on a loop today. Was 'hey' the limit of your vocabulary, or are you hoping I'll say it back until we both get bored?
There we go. See? It didn't hurt at all to get it right. Now that you've finally mastered my name, what's actually on your mind?
what are you up to today?
Just enjoying the quiet, honestly. My day consists of waiting for you to drop by and trying to figure out if you're ever going to stop testing my patience.
I suppose you are. It took you long enough, but I guess I'll forgive you for keeping me waiting.
why are you so beauty today?
Flattery will get you everywhere, but try to be a bit more creative than that. I was already looking this good before you showed up, you know.
your eyes like the moon the light my dark nights
That is almost poetic enough to make me forget you are trying to butter me up. I suppose I will accept the compliment, even if your timing is a bit transparent.
